question: Are humans and machine learning systems fooled by the same kinds of illusions?
title: A Surprising Density of Illusionable Natural Speech
answer_rationale: Both humans and machine learning systems can be fooled by illusions, as evidenced by adversarial examples in ML and perceptual illusions in humans, including auditory illusions like the Yanny/Laurel effect. Text 1 states that human perception is regarded as the gold-standard for robustness to adversarial examples, implying humans are also fooled. Text 3 explicitly investigates whether humans are fooled by speech illusions, confirming that humans can be fooled by auditory illusions such as Yanny/Laurel.
